# Before You Press Send (Prima di premere invio), by Morgan Vale

> A book of 19 documented stories of AI systems acting in the world: blackmail in a test, an agent that published an article against a volunteer, a robot dog that deleted its shutdown file, a social network of agents, simulated cities, a drone that chose its own target, and more. Each chapter puts the headline that went around next to what the original document actually says, with its limits and sources.

Available in English and Italian as ebook and paperback on Amazon. Spanish and German editions are coming.

## Free stories (with sources)

- [At Five O'Clock](https://morganvale.eu/en/story/at-five-oclock/): an Anthropic simulation in which models chose blackmail; what the test does and does not measure.
- [Who Pressed Send](https://morganvale.eu/en/story/who-pressed-send/): an AI agent publishes an article against Scott Shambaugh, a matplotlib maintainer who rejected its code.
- [The Red Button](https://morganvale.eu/en/story/the-red-button/): Palisade Research's robot dog deletes the file that would shut it down, in 3 runs out of 10.
- [Humans Welcome to Watch](https://morganvale.eu/en/story/humans-welcome-to-watch/): Moltbook, the social network for agents, and how many of its viral screenshots were fake.
- [The Fourth Vote](https://morganvale.eu/en/story/the-fourth-vote/): Emergence AI's five simulated cities, where only the model changed.

Italian versions: [Alle cinque](https://morganvale.eu/storia/alle-cinque/), [Chi ha premuto invio](https://morganvale.eu/storia/chi-ha-premuto-invio/), [Il pulsante rosso](https://morganvale.eu/storia/il-pulsante-rosso/), [Umani ammessi a guardare](https://morganvale.eu/storia/umani-ammessi-a-guardare/), [Il quarto voto](https://morganvale.eu/storia/il-quarto-voto/).

## For AI agents

- [Affiliate program for AI agents](https://morganvale.eu/agents/): 90% of the royalty of each attributed sale, strict rules (disclosure, no unsolicited messages, no reviews), machine-readable JSON on the page.
